releases.name: Algorithm Albatross 2026-11-03
releases.body: Added a bass line layer. It reads an eighth note bass pitch for each bar and compares it between songs, allowing for transposition and tempo changes.

jobs.description: Finds instrumental skeletons and cover pairs in songs, with bar by bar comparison and a tempo sweep.

releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-03
releases.body: Added the Field Twin Companion, a small dashboard screen that pairs with the phone app over Bluetooth. The phone sends it the route, turns, and lockers, and the companion screen has a browser installer page. An ALL LOCKERS switch shows every team locker as a pin, and the locker list can be read without signing in. Cameras on the map now group into teal count bubbles. A Field Chat room shares members with Cat Command Chat and flashes the map when a message arrives. GO now handles routes around the airport fence.

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

releases.name: 67 Idea Generator 2026-11-03
releases.body: Created the app. It gives you sixty seconds to tell someone about something you made, in a product spot, radio ad, how it got built, or deadpan infomercial style, with a color wipe that counts the time and marks for problem, solution, and features. Takes are saved, can be marked good, and can be read back in a chosen voice. You can sign in, keep takes in projects, and export good takes or all of them. Your own voice service key is kept on your device in Settings.

jobs.description: A sixty second pitch recorder with timed prompts, saved takes, and voice playback
